คณะกรรมาธิการคือคณะของสมาชิกวุฒิสภาที่ทำ: A committee is a group of senators who work on a particular area. The Committee on Laws and Justice looks after law, the administration of justice, the justice process, the police, public prosecutors, corrections and equal access to justice. For example, it considers matters sent in by the public, invites state agencies to explain, studies draft laws and reports to the Senate

A committee is a group of senators who work on a specific area. The Committee on Military Affairs and State Security looks after military affairs, the defence industry and holistic security, for example by studying the border situation, inviting state agencies to clarify matters, considering matters raised by the public, and reporting to the Senate

A committee is a group of senators who work on a specific area. The Committee on Administration of State Affairs looks after public administration, for example hearing petitions from the public, asking state agencies for information, studying various matters and reporting to the Senate

A committee is a group of senators who work on a particular area. The Committee on Public Health looks after the health system, medical treatment, the gold card scheme and treatment rights, medical personnel, disease prevention and people's access to services. For example, it invites state agencies to explain, studies health bills, listens to those affected and makes recommendations to the government and the Senate

A committee is a group of senators who work on a specific area. The Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives looks after agriculture, fisheries, livestock, land and water for farming, food and cooperatives, for example by studying farmers’ problems, asking state agencies for information, considering matters raised by the public, and reporting to the Senate

A committee is a group of senators who work on a particular area. The Committee on Labour covers Thai and migrant workers, Thai workers abroad, self-employed people, labour welfare and protection, social security and safety at work. For example, it considers matters sent in by the public, invites state agencies to clarify, studies draft laws and reports to the Senate
